items.html: It is thus found that there is also the phase of other Mochin that clothed in the third Hochma of the first six Sefirot of Hochma within it, which is up to its Chazeh. It is thus found that there are two images, male and female — this one the phase of Haya, and that one the phase of Neshama. And the image of Aba becomes a Neshama for the image of Ima, and clothes within it and is concealed there; therefore we always speak only of the image of Ima, and from it the image of Aba will be explained. Remember this and do not forget.
